Single retained session can carry multiple application records (baseline + first image) -> design target MET: ONE USB session, ONE TLS server/session, ONE handshake, ONE validated secret boundary, ZERO second PSK provisioning, ZERO transport reopen

redesign_assessment.rationale: The TLS layer already supports a single retained session spanning handshake->baseline->0x32->IRQ2->0x22->first-image. The gap is coordinator/machine orchestration glue (a post-arm phase + one machine method), not a TLS/transport redesign. Per prompt rule, this is NOT BLOCKED on redesign; it is an extension gap recorded for step 03.
